C6_library_C_ladder_and_B26.why_this_is_strong: B-26 was run in a different library, from a different DOE, as a different batch, and nothing in the paper presents it as a replicate. Its value landing inside the bracket its Library C neighbours draw is an independent corroboration of both.

Reported because it is a measured within-lab reproducibility figure, not because the paper presents it as one.

C9_ranks.benchmark_is: 'Original' -- the C12-200 formulation previously optimized for siRNA (50/10/38.5/1.5 DSPC, 5:1 wt), i.e. the field-standard starting point this paper sets out to beat
C9_ranks.name: rank of the benchmark and of the declared optimum
C9_ranks.note: The declared 'optimized formulation' C-35 is NOT the maximum of the screen: C-36 (7548) and B-26 (7485) both exceed it. C-35 was selected as the Library B regression optimum and Library C was the confirmation ladder run around it, so this is a model optimum reported as the optimized formulation, not a selection-into-a-second-screen tautology.

C10_phospholipid_effect.note: The only chemical identity that varies in this paper, and it is a HELPER lipid, not the ionizable lipid.

C11_three_way_helper_concordance.independence_posture: This is a NAME-CONCORDANCE check, NOT an external attestation of this paper's chemistry. The paper draws no structure; it prints a systematic name, and all three legs of this comparison are derivations from that same name by different hands. It catches a transcription error in any leg -- and the briefing records a sibling whose hand-built DSPC came out a ketone bearing an ether at the right mass to six decimals -- but it cannot catch a name that is wrong FOR THIS PAPER. Counted as such in PROVENANCE.md and NOT counted as a C10 pass.

C12_amine_200_arm_count._what_this_proves: Within a homologous series holding the amine fixed and walking the tail length, dC/d(tail) EQUALS the number of arms. KW_2014's A200_C10..C14 gives 5 arms on a 5-nitrogen core; KL_2010's 200C8..C14 gives 1 arm on a 3-nitrogen core. Both series are INTERNALLY self-consistent, which is precisely why F-061 is a real conflict and not a typo: two curations each coherently encode a different molecule for the same catalogue amine. Reported; data/ untouched.

positive_control_cKK_E12.why: F-070. A structure can sit under several names; this one is documented as CKK-E12 / other / MD-1. If the InChIKey join cannot reproduce that, the join is broken and a zero means nothing.

C12_200.same_shape_as_positive_control: yes -- 20 extra rows recovered under the name 'other' in JW_2024, exactly as cKK-E12 hides 19 there

in_vivo_shared.why: C12-200 appears in 0 in-vivo experiments today (518 rows, all in vitro, AC_2025 + JW_2024). Adding ONE in-vivo experiment takes it from 0 to 1, and a structure needs >=2 in-vivo experiments to be shared. So KK_2015 would create the FIRST in-vivo C12-200 rows and still leave the in-vivo shared set at exactly DLin-MC3-DMA and SM-102. It does however create a vitro<->vivo bridge for a 518-row structure, which is a different and smaller thing.

substructure_sweep_SUPERSET.LABEL: SUPERSET. The loose and strict tiers are chemotype supersets, not identity. Only the exact tier is identity.
substructure_sweep_SUPERSET.positive_control: C12-200 itself matches at the loose, strict and exact tiers. Asserted in code; the sweep raises if it does not.

tier_loose.means: any amine bearing a 2-hydroxyalkyl arm, i.e. the epoxide-ring-opening chemotype

tier_strict.means: the amine-200 pentaamine core AND a hydroxyalkyl arm

token_pattern.contiguity_note: F-055: the amine catalogue is sparse and non-contiguous, so a contiguous 1..N name would mean LOCAL indices. '200' is a catalogue index, not a local one.

naive_substring_damage.verdict: a naive substring join on '200' returns 526 rows spanning 24 names and 24 distinct structures with at least three incompatible chemotypes. Never used; the join here is on InChIKey.

token_pattern.pattern: C<tail length>-<amine catalogue index>. 'C12' is the tail (a 2-hydroxydodecyl arm from 1,2-epoxydodecane); '200' is the index of the polyamine core in this lab's amine catalogue.
token_pattern.which_token_is_which_PROVEN_BY: structural attestation, not a substring guess: in KW_2014 the A200_* series holds '200' FIXED while the tail token runs C10..C14, and all five of those structures contain the same 5-nitrogen pentaamine core; the carbon count is what changes. So '200' names the core and the C-number names the tail. KK_2015 writes the two tokens in the OPPOSITE order from KL_2010's '200C12'.

experiment_id.derivation: FIRST author Kauffman, Kevin J. + 2015. The folder is named andersondg_26469188 after the PI, which is not the corpus key.

C14_text_extraction_geometry.why_geometric: Table S4's READING ORDER IS NOT ITS VISUAL ORDER: the dose cell is vertically centred, so each formulation's first dose line sorts ABOVE its own code label. A line-order parser recovered 6 of 8 value rows and dropped the two 0.1 mg/kg points silently. Doses are therefore assigned by NATIVE TEXT y-coordinate (the PDF's own character positions, not pixels), each to its nearest phospholipid anchor.
C14_text_extraction_geometry.margin_interpretation: The tightest decision is 9.40 pt to the correct anchor against 18.68 pt to the wrong one, a 1.99x margin on a 28.08 pt anchor separation and a ~9.1 pt row pitch. Every one of the 6 dose bands is assigned by at least that margin, and the parser asserts each formulation receives exactly the dose set {0.01, 0.03, 0.1} rather than trusting the margin.
C14_text_extraction_geometry.em_dash_note: One, on B-29. pdfplumber fuses a hyphen run into U+2014. Accepted only because width 5 forces exactly two hyphens AND the result satisfies all 5 of B-29's coded-level assertions independently (08_contradictions.csv C-06).

A_DEFECT_FOUND_IN_OUR_OWN_CODE.what: _fix_emdash's first version returned early whenever len(s) == want, so an em-dash string that happened to be the right width came back with the em dash still in it. check_coded_levels would then have indexed that character as a design level, adding a fourth key to a three-key char->level map and MASKING a violation.
A_DEFECT_FOUND_IN_OUR_OWN_CODE.found_by: its own seed (emdash_width_guard), which scored 1 of 3 refusals
A_DEFECT_FOUND_IN_OUR_OWN_CODE.after_fix: 3 of 3 refusals; the character set is now validated on the way OUT unconditionally and length alone never buys an exit
A_DEFECT_FOUND_IN_OUR_OWN_CODE.output_change: none -- B-29 was the only affected row and was already handled correctly
A_DEFECT_FOUND_IN_OUR_OWN_CODE.class: the 'a check that canonicalises its input has given up the ability to detect non-canonical input' shape (error class 37), in our own code

C16_anchor_posture.paper_draws_nothing: There is not one chemical structure drawing in the 14 SI pages. Per-page object counts: the 8 text pages hold 0 image objects, and the 6 image pages are Fig S1 (regression plots), Fig S2 (EE and size trends), Fig S3 (a methodology flowchart), Fig S4 (TEM micrographs) and two pages of JMP screenshots.
C16_anchor_posture.C12_200_anchor: NONE. reference_SMILES is EMPTY on purpose so the absence is visible. No drawing, no formula, no HRMS, no MW, no synthesis.
C16_anchor_posture.what_that_anchor_IS: a NAME-CONCORDANCE anchor. The SI spells the systematic names out in its footnotes, and make_reference.py re-derives structures from those names by a head-first assemble.attach route. All three legs of the comparison are derivations from the SAME name by different hands.
C16_anchor_posture.what_that_anchor_IS_NOT: an external structural attestation of this paper's chemistry. It would catch a transcription error in any leg -- the briefing records a sibling whose hand-built DSPC came out a ketone bearing an ether at the right mass to six decimals -- but it cannot catch a name that is wrong FOR THIS PAPER. NOT counted as a C10 pass.
C16_anchor_posture.cholesterol: NOT hand-written and NOT anchored. The paper gives only the abbreviation 'Chol.'. CHL_SMILES is populated from provenance/reagent_registry.py and that registry pin is explicitly NOT counted as an anchor.
C16_anchor_posture.independence_verified_how: make_reference.py walks ITS OWN AST at run time and inspects Call, Import and ImportFrom nodes ONLY, so the ban list cannot match itself (a substring scan over the source would flag the ban list inside its own docstring -- one sibling's guard failed on its own module for exactly that). 8 import nodes and 168 call nodes examined, 0 findings. A template-provenance guard additionally requires that no string literal of >= 25 chars in the module be a substring of any emitted structure: 54 literals examined, 0 hits.
C16_anchor_posture.byte_identity_is_not_the_signal: F-037. The built DSPC/DOPE/DOPC canonicalise byte-identically to the registry's strings, and that is EXPECTED: a correct re-derivation is byte-identical to a correct stored structure. Testing for byte-difference is the trap. What is tested is the ROUTE, by AST.
C16_anchor_posture.stereo_assertions_are_NOT_vacuous: DSPC, DOPE and DOPC each have exactly 1 real stereocentre (glycerol C2), asserted (R) from the sn convention. Seed make_reference_stereo flips the backbone tag and the assertion fires, reporting (S). Double-bond geometry is asserted explicitly: 2 C=C, 2 Z, 0 unassigned for the dioleoyl lipids; 0 C=C for DSPC.
C16_anchor_posture.connectivity_gate_proven: Seed make_reference_regioisomer builds 1,3-diacyl-glycero-2-phospho DSPC: IDENTICAL formula C44H88NO8P, exact-mass delta 0.000000 Da, different InChIKey. The assembly route REFUSES it -- via assemble.check_stereo_preserved, because C2 stops being stereogenic when both CH2 arms become identical. So the gate sees connectivity, not mass.
C16_anchor_posture.MEASURED_SENSITIVITY_LIMIT: make_reference's OWN assertions (C2=R, C=C count, Z count, no unassigned) CANNOT see double-bond POSITION. Seed three_way_delta6 moves the oleoyl double bond from delta-9 to delta-6: every internal assertion still passes, formula identical, exact-mass delta 0.000000 Da. ONLY the three-way InChIKey comparison catches it, and it does. That is the honest limit of this curation's structural gates.

C17_seeded_mutation_suite.F069_posture: Every seed runs in a CHILD PROCESS with its own temp OUTDIR; nothing a seed writes can land in the curation folder, and the 7 tracked artifacts are sha256-compared before and after the whole suite. Verdicts come from returncode, never from a pipeline's exit status.
C17_seeded_mutation_suite.A_SEED_THAT_ONLY_RAISES_IS_NOT_CREDITED: each seed must print a METRIC line naming the quantity it moved; a child that dies before its metric is reported NOT CREDITED even on a non-zero exit
